cases.sentence: Когда молодой ___ это услышал, то отошел опечаленный.
cases.translation: When the young man heard this, he went away sad.
cases.explain: Человек is the subject of the verb услышал, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Иисус отправился по восточному берегу ___ в Иудею.
cases.translation: Jesus went along the eastern bank of the Jordan into Judea.
cases.explain: The noun берег (bank) takes a genitive complement — the bank OF the Jordan.

cases.sentence: Также говорю вам, легче ___ пройти сквозь игольное ушко, чем богатому войти в Божье царство.
cases.translation: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter God's kingdom.
cases.explain: The impersonal construction легче + dative (легче кому-то) puts the logical subject верблюд in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Закончив говорить это, Иисус покинул ___ и отправился по восточному берегу Иордана в Иудею.
cases.translation: When Jesus had finished these words, he left Galilee and went along the eastern bank of the Jordan into Judea.
cases.explain: The transitive verb покинуть (to leave) takes its direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: И всякий, кто оставил дома ради меня, получит во сто крат больше и станет ___ вечной жизни.
cases.translation: And everyone who has left houses for my sake will receive a hundred times more and will become an heir of eternal life.
cases.explain: The verb стать (to become) requires its predicate noun in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Тогда и вы, последовавшие за мной, тоже сядете на двенадцати ___.
cases.translation: Then you also, who have followed me, will sit on twelve thrones.
cases.explain: The preposition на denoting location (sitting on something) governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Некоторые из фарисеев подошли к Иисусу и, искушая Его, спросили, «По любой ли причине мужчине разрешается разводиться со своей женой?»
reading.question: What did the Pharisees ask Jesus about?
options: Whether a man may divorce his wife for any reason
Whether taxes should be paid to Caesar
Whether the Sabbath could be broken
reading.correct: Whether a man may divorce his wife for any reason
reading.explain: The Pharisees asked, 'Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?'

reading.ru: «Моисей разрешил вам разводиться с женами из-за жестокости ваших сердец», — ответил им Иисус.
reading.question: Why, according to Jesus, did Moses permit divorce?
options: Because of the hardness of their hearts
Because it was a Roman law
reading.correct: Because of the hardness of their hearts
reading.explain: Jesus said Moses allowed divorce 'из-за жестокости ваших сердец' (because of the hardness of your hearts).

reading.ru: а третьи отказались от брака ради небесного царства, пусть те, кому это дано, поступают так
reading.question: Why did some people, according to Jesus, give up marriage?
options: For the sake of the kingdom of heaven
reading.correct: For the sake of the kingdom of heaven
reading.explain: Jesus said some 'отказались от брака ради небесного царства' (renounced marriage for the sake of the kingdom of heaven).

reading.ru: Но Иисус сказал, «Пусть дети приходят ко Мне, не запрещайте им, потому что Царство Небесное принадлежит таким, как они».
reading.question: What did Jesus say about the children brought to him?
options: That the kingdom of heaven belongs to ones like them
That they should wait until they were older
That they should be sent home
That only their parents could approach him
reading.correct: That the kingdom of heaven belongs to ones like them
reading.explain: Jesus said 'Царство Небесное принадлежит таким, как они' (the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these).

reading.ru: Если хочешь быть совершенным, то пойди, продай то, что у тебя есть, и раздай деньги бедным, и тогда у тебя будет сокровище на небесах.
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the rich young man to do to be perfect?
options: Sell his possessions and give the money to the poor
Become a teacher of the law
reading.correct: Sell his possessions and give the money to the poor
reading.explain: Jesus told him to 'продай то, что у тебя есть, и раздай деньги бедным' (sell what you have and give the money to the poor).

reading.ru: «Также говорю вам, легче верблюду пройти сквозь игольное ушко, чем богатому войти в Божье царство».
reading.question: What comparison does Jesus make about a rich man entering God's kingdom?
options: It is easier for a camel to pass through a needle's eye
It is easier for a bird to fly without wings
It is easier for a fish to live on land
It is easier for a lamp to burn without oil
reading.correct: It is easier for a camel to pass through a needle's eye
reading.explain: Jesus said it is 'легче верблюду пройти сквозь игольное ушко' (easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye) than for a rich man to enter God's kingdom.

reading.ru: тогда и вы, последовавшие за мной, тоже сядете на двенадцати престолах, править двенадцатью родами Израиля»
reading.question: What did Jesus promise the disciples who followed him?
options: That they would sit on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel
That they would rule over Rome
reading.correct: That they would sit on twelve thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel
reading.explain: Jesus said the disciples would 'сядете на двенадцати престолах, править двенадцатью родами Израиля' (sit on twelve thrones, ruling the twelve tribes of Israel).
